purpose: Official legal, occupancy and commercial-property due-diligence sources. No candidate-specific result is asserted until an address, title number or exact geometry query is executed.

sources.coverage: registered local land charges and restrictions affecting land or property in migrated authority areas
sources.binding_limit: The service can bind by title, INSPIRE ID, coordinates or map geometry, but it does not include planning applications, building control or nearby road schemes. CON29 remains a separate local-authority enquiry.

sources.coverage: Rugby CON29 enquiries, planning and road-related property information, common-land search routes and local search fees
sources.binding_limit: Rugby states that ownership is not held in the Local Land Charges Register. A site location plan is required for candidate-specific CON29 or EIR information, and questions 4 and 16 have separate limitations.

sources.coverage: rateable values and valuation summaries for non-domestic property in England and Wales
sources.binding_limit: A rateable-value record supports commercial occupation and assessment context but does not establish ownership, vacant possession, sale authority, planning permission or cadastral extent.

sources.publisher: Charity Commission for England and Wales
sources.coverage: registered charity identity, reporting status and contact address; used here to corroborate the 4-6 Kimberley Road organisation-address relationship
sources.binding_limit: A charity contact address corroborates identity and occupation/contact context only. It does not verify ownership, title extent, authority to sell, planning use or vacant possession.
